**Finding submitted: deviation (AUDIT).**

- **Clause located:** Article II, §IV(b) "Record Keeping and Reports" (p0073), with the cost-allocation sentence at p0064.
- **What already works for us:** independent CPA/Audit Professional selected by mutual agreement; 30 days' lead time; accounting-records-only review (no access to our systems); Licensor bears cost unless a >5% discrepancy is found — that is the preferred cost split, better than the 10% fallback.
- **Why it still fails:** no cap on audit frequency at all, which permits repeated or effectively unlimited audits — walk-away territory and short of the fallback's once-per-year limit.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** adds a once-per-twelve-months cap, business-hours/no-unreasonable-interference conduct, and a confidentiality-bound auditor, with notice and cost allocation left as drafted.
